summary: publish_presentation_event gets the caller it has never had: status changes for stunned, webbed and immobilized, on and off, derived from already-parsed flags

coordination.notes: No text is parsed: the changes come from comparing two already-parsed CharacterStatus.situation lists, so the bridge's one opinion about what stunned means stays the only one. Both directions are published, because a viewer told only about the onset leaves the character helpless on screen forever. The event sequence is its own counter, separate from presentationBridge.ts's snapshot sequence - two streams sharing one counter would make a gap in either look like a dropped message in the other - and it advances only after Rust accepted the publish, the same rule publishWorldSnapshotIfChanged follows. dying is deliberately not published: it is in the alert set because it needs a person's attention, and it is not a pose.
coordination.deviations: The plan predicts the callerless-command sweep will then list only extract_lich and bridge_install_status. It lists three: those two plus install_bundled_ruby. publish_presentation_event has gone from the list, which is what this increment was for; the third is outside this lane and is reported rather than rounded away.
